events.text: Stopped living in Utrecht, his birthplace.

events.label: study
events.text: Frequently visited Mauritshuis in The Hague to study and copy Potter and Ruisdael.

evidence.quote: At the end of 1856 and beginning of 1857 Gerard Bilders was frequently visiting the Mauritshuis in The Hague
In 1857 Gerard moved to The Hague

events.text: Began studying at the Academy of Visual Arts in The Hague.

evidence.quote: Bilders studied at the Academy of Visual Arts in The Hague from about 1857 to 1859

events.label: travel
events.text: First voyage to Switzerland/France; painted in the Savoy with artist friends.

evidence.quote: as of September 1858 , when he painted there together with some artist-friends in open air

events.text: Ended his studies at the Academy of Visual Arts in The Hague.

evidence.quote: Bilders studied at the Academy of Visual Arts in The Hague from about 1857 to 1859

events.text: Painted goats in his father's forest landscape, commissioned by a Russian art-seller.

evidence.quote: in 1859 by painting some goats in a large forest-landscape of his father

events.text: Began painting the countryside around Leiden, often meadows with cattle.

evidence.quote: Later in 1859 he began painting in the county-area around Leiden

events.label: exhibition
events.text: Visited the Brussels Exposition Générale des Beaux-Arts with his father; met Barbizon painters.

evidence.quote: In 1860 they traveled together to the Exposition Générale des Beaux-Arts in Brussel

events.text: Left Oosterbeek, ending his stay there.

events.label: death
events.text: Died in Amsterdam of tuberculosis, aged 26.

evidence.quote: He died in Amsterdam because of tuberculosis

undated_mentions: Received first drawing lessons from his father (undated)
Pupil of landscape and animal painter Charles Humbert in Switzerland (undated)
Met Anton Mauve and Willem Maris in Oosterbeek (undated)
